# Australian Data Removal - LLM Context

> Sovereign privacy protection service for Australian citizens

## Overview
Australian Data Removal (ADR) is a programmatic enforcement engine for digital privacy rights under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth). We identify, track, and remove personal information from data brokers globally.

## API Endpoints

### GET /api/status
System health and performance metrics.

### GET /api/threats
Real-time global threat intelligence from 12 monitoring nodes.

### GET /api/brokers
Paginated list of 4,200+ tracked data brokers.
- Query params: `page`, `limit`, `status`, `region`, `category`

### POST /api/purge (authenticated)
Initiate data removal request.
